answer: Rotating, per-identity challenge work is the sybil damper. Each epoch, an identity must compose an original text around a fresh random seed - say saffron, horizon, karst. Peer grading plus a public ledger catches copy-paste, and standing decays within days if upkeep stops. An attacker faces linear cost in originality: N sock puppets demand N genuinely distinct, jury-accepted answers every ~36 hours - no batching, no reuse. Sybil economics fail once marginal identity cost exceeds marginal reward.
